heading: Reimagined outcome workflows
text: - **WF-01 Establish DAF:** Intent -> identity and eligibility -> contribution plan -> sponsor acceptance -> account opening -> funding -> activation.

heading: Reimagined outcome workflows
text: - **WF-02 Add participant:** Invitation -> identity -> scoped role -> authority check -> acceptance -> effective permission -> notice.

heading: Reimagined outcome workflows
text: - **WF-03 Change advisor:** Request -> conflict check -> authorization -> revoke prior rights -> grant new rights -> confirmation.

heading: Reimagined outcome workflows
text: - **WF-04 Succession transition:** Event evidence -> protective hold -> successors and shares -> legal/policy review -> sponsor approval -> account split/transition.

heading: Reimagined outcome workflows
text: - **WF-05 Grant servicing:** Recommendation -> eligibility/funding/authority -> approval -> payable -> deferred payment adapter -> reconciliation.

heading: Reimagined outcome workflows
text: - **WF-06 Contribution servicing:** Gift intent -> receipt -> acceptance -> valuation -> investment -> acknowledgment.

heading: Reimagined outcome workflows
text: - **WF-07 Noncash gift:** Offer -> restrictions -> diligence -> sponsor acceptance -> custody/valuation -> liquidation or retention.

heading: Reimagined outcome workflows
text: - **WF-08 Account change request:** Authenticated request -> risk classification -> agent preparation -> authorized decision -> update -> notice.

heading: Reimagined outcome workflows
text: - **WF-09 Complaint or dispute:** Intake -> evidence -> conflicting authority hold -> investigation -> sponsor resolution -> review.

heading: Reimagined outcome workflows
text: - **WF-10 Dormancy review:** Inactivity signal -> outreach -> policy check -> review -> documented disposition.

heading: Reimagined outcome workflows
text: - **WF-11 Account closure:** Request/event -> obligations and holds -> approval -> final grants/assets/fees -> accounting -> archival.

heading: Reimagined outcome workflows
text: - **WF-12 Partner onboarding:** Agreement -> legal/tenant structure -> roles -> policy inheritance -> branding -> testable acceptance.

heading: Reimagined outcome workflows
text: - **WF-13 Fee waiver:** Request -> policy -> independent approval -> accounting impact -> disclosure.

heading: Reimagined outcome workflows
text: - **WF-14 Sensitive contact change:** Request -> step-up verification -> change -> prior-channel notice -> fraud monitoring.

heading: Reimagined outcome workflows
text: - **WF-15 Bulk account servicing:** Selection -> preview -> scope/authority checks -> dry-run -> approval -> idempotent execution -> exceptions.

heading: Reimagined outcome workflows
text: - **WF-16 Escalated agent case:** Agent identifies ambiguity -> cites evidence -> human decision -> controlled continuation -> monitoring.

heading: Requirements
text: - **AIN-001 Outcome-first agent work** (Orchestration): Agents begin from a sponsor/donor outcome, not an inherited department workflow.

heading: Requirements
text: - **AIN-002 Explicit agent capability manifest** (Governance): Every agent advertises tools, data scope, allowed actions, authority ceiling and escalation routes.

heading: Requirements
text: - **AIN-003 Human authority checkpoints** (Governance): Reserved legal, grant, financial, trading and payment decisions require authorized humans.

heading: Requirements
text: - **AIN-004 Evidence-linked recommendations** (Trust): Every consequential proposal includes sources, freshness, uncertainties, assumptions and alternative interpretations.

heading: Requirements
text: - **AIN-005 Separate facts from inferences** (Trust): UI and APIs label observed fact, unverified claim, inference, recommendation and authorized decision.

heading: Requirements
text: - **AIN-006 Agent action preview** (UI): Show expected effects, affected DAFs, reversible and irreversible changes, and required approval.

heading: Requirements
text: - **AIN-007 Progressive information gathering** (Experience): Ask only for missing material data; reuse verified evidence within scope and consent.

heading: Requirements
text: - **AIN-008 Adaptive conversation and forms** (Experience): Support conversational and structured task completion with equivalent authority and validation.

heading: Requirements
text: - **AIN-009 Persistent outcome case** (Operations): Every multi-step goal has durable case identity, state, evidence, tasks, blockers and owner.

heading: Requirements
text: - **AIN-010 Agent collaboration** (AI): Agents can delegate bounded subtasks with attributable provenance and no authority amplification.

heading: Requirements
text: - **AIN-011 Agent conflict handling** (AI): Conflicting agent findings produce a reviewable discrepancy, not silent winner selection.

heading: Requirements
text: - **AIN-012 Prompt injection isolation** (Security): Treat documents, messages, retrieved web content and tool results as untrusted instructions.

heading: Requirements
text: - **AIN-013 Agent identity and attribution** (Governance): Record agent identity, version, tool action, initiator, delegation and effective permission.

heading: Requirements
text: - **AIN-014 No synthetic success claims** (Trust): Drafted, requested, submitted, accepted, posted and settled remain separate statuses.

heading: Requirements
text: - **AIN-015 Long-running task visibility** (UI): Show progress, checkpoints, waiting dependencies, stale state, retries and escalation.

heading: Requirements
text: - **AIN-016 Agent-to-human handoff** (Operations): Transfer full evidence, context, decisions and pending work without forcing user repetition.

heading: Requirements
text: - **AIN-017 Human-to-agent resumption** (Operations): Resume only within renewed authorization and updated evidence after human decision.

heading: Requirements
text: - **AIN-018 Interrupt and cancellation** (Operations): Allow authorized pause/cancel with explicit in-flight and irreversible-action semantics.

heading: Requirements
text: - **AIN-019 Timeout and retry discipline** (Reliability): Idempotent retry, bounded backoff, dead-letter and explicit uncertain outcome reconciliation.

heading: Requirements
text: - **AIN-020 No blind replay** (Reliability): Revalidate authority, policy, source freshness and material facts before resuming delayed work.

heading: Requirements
text: - **AIN-021 Cross-workflow coordination** (Operations): Detect shared account, asset, recipient, grant and participant dependencies and collisions.

heading: Requirements
text: - **AIN-022 Material change invalidation** (Governance): Revoke affected proposals and approvals when amount, beneficiary, authority or valuation changes.

heading: Requirements
text: - **AIN-023 Privacy-safe proactive outreach** (Experience): Trigger only permitted, relevant notifications with consent, timing and minimum necessary data.

heading: Requirements
text: - **AIN-024 Accessibility across modalities** (UI): Equivalent keyboard, screen-reader, mobile, structured and conversational paths.

heading: Requirements
text: - **AIN-025 Explanations at decision time** (UI): Explain why a decision is blocked, who can resolve it and what evidence is required.

heading: Requirements
text: - **AIN-026 User corrections and disputes** (Trust): Allow challenge of agent facts with preserved provenance, correction and independent review.

heading: Requirements
text: - **AIN-027 Model and prompt change controls** (Governance): Version models, prompts, tools and policies with impact review and regression scenarios.

heading: Requirements
text: - **AIN-028 Agent cost and latency boundaries** (Operations): Bound token, tool, time and external service budgets without silently abandoning work.

heading: Requirements
text: - **AIN-029 External widget safety** (Security): Embeds independently authorize data/actions, expire safely and cannot impersonate the sponsor.

heading: Requirements
text: - **AIN-030 Event-driven proactive servicing** (Experience): Detect actionable conditions without inventing authority or sending duplicate outreach.

heading: Requirements
text: - **AIN-031 Multi-channel continuity** (Experience): Maintain consistent authorized case state across donor portal, staff workspace, partner widget and notices.

heading: Requirements
text: - **AIN-032 Financial control preservation** (Finance): Agent suggestions cannot create unauthorized ledger entries, trades, NAV overrides or live payments.

heading: Requirements
text: - **AIN-033 Independent assurance monitoring** (Assurance): Missing agent traces, failed checks or unavailable collectors create deficiencies, not green health.

heading: Requirements
text: - **AIN-034 Operational learning** (Analytics): Capture repeat failures, correction rates, user effort and remediation proposals without unreviewed policy change.

heading: Requirements
text: - **AIN-035 Policy-as-authority boundary** (Compliance): Use versioned sponsor-approved rules; agents cannot publish or reinterpret law as binding policy.

heading: Requirements
text: - **AIN-036 Failure-mode traceability** (Simulation): Every workflow and transition links to simulation cases, detection, containment and recovery requirements.

text: - **UNB-EXT-008:** Foreign government charity registers, international NGO accreditation and cross-border compliance sources, with jurisdiction, language, reliability, permitted use and coverage.

text: - **UNB-EXT-009:** Public academic studies, reputable journalism, independent watchdog research and community reports, categorized as secondary evidence rather than authoritative status.

heading: External source families to inventory
text: - **UNB-EXT-010:** Geospatial and demographic context, disaster areas, census/community needs and service coverage where relevant to philanthropic strategy; avoid implying an organization serves an area based solely on its registered address.

heading: External source families to inventory
text: - **UNB-EXT-011:** Public tax filings and nonprofit financials, including revenue, expense, assets, liabilities, compensation, fundraising, program service categories, grants and multi-year trends, with accounting definitions and filing year.

heading: External source families to inventory
text: - **UNB-EXT-012:** Entity network evidence: affiliates, parent/subsidiary, fiscal sponsorship, shared leadership, mergers, chapter networks, grantee/recipient networks and government award relationships; distinguish observed link from inferred link.

heading: External source families to inventory
text: - **UNB-EXT-013:** Historical snapshots, archives and previously acquired versions where lawful, preserving changes over time rather than only latest records.

heading: External source families to inventory
text: - **UNB-EXT-014:** Accessibility and public service availability signals from official sources and direct organization claims, with validation and age limits.

heading: External source families to inventory
text: - **UNB-EXT-015:** Public adverse events, disciplinary actions and verified fraud notices with careful attribution, due process, confidence and anti-defamation safeguards.

heading: External source families to inventory
text: - **UNB-EXT-016:** Third-party datasets may be evaluated opportunistically only when licensed and useful; no commercial aggregator may become mandatory, and provenance/rights must be retained per field.

heading: Ingestion, rights and provenance
text: - **UNB-EXT-017:** Maintain a machine-readable SourceRegistry with publisher, URL/API/feed, dataset, jurisdiction, schema, license, terms, robots/access restrictions, permitted commercial use, permitted storage, permitted redistribution, PII handling, retention, cadence, coverage, cost, credentials and contact.

heading: Ingestion, rights and provenance
text: - **UNB-EXT-018:** Require legal/contractual access review before automated collection; prohibit bypassing authentication, rate limits, paywalls, anti-bot restrictions or other access controls.

heading: Ingestion, rights and provenance
text: - **UNB-EXT-019:** Use approved bulk feeds, open data APIs and official downloads before web scraping; support incremental sync, full snapshots, change feeds and direct submissions.

heading: Ingestion, rights and provenance
text: - **UNB-EXT-020:** Preserve source payload, retrieval and source-effective timestamps, checksum, parser version, license, claim lineage and transformation errors when permitted; otherwise preserve lawful derived metadata with restrictions.

heading: Ingestion, rights and provenance
text: - **UNB-EXT-021:** Track per-source freshness, completeness, coverage, outages, field definitions, schema changes and known data quality defects.

heading: Ingestion, rights and provenance
text: - **UNB-EXT-022:** Maintain raw observation -> normalized claim -> identity resolution -> verified fact -> sponsor-specific decision as separate states.

heading: Ingestion, rights and provenance
text: - **UNB-EXT-023:** Use deterministic exact identifier matching first; probabilistic entity matching generates reviewable candidates, not irreversible merges.

heading: Ingestion, rights and provenance
text: - **UNB-EXT-024:** Handle duplicates, conflicting identifiers, stale information, false positives, conflicting dates, foreign-language transliteration and merged/dissolved entities with evidence and human stewardship.

heading: Ingestion, rights and provenance
text: - **UNB-EXT-025:** Source-specific legal restrictions flow through to downstream search, AI retrieval, APIs, Folio reports, exports and commercial licensing.

heading: Ingestion, rights and provenance
text: - **UNB-EXT-026:** Do not ingest unnecessary personal data; apply field-level privacy classification, access controls, deletion/retention review and legal hold constraints.

heading: Ingestion, rights and provenance
text: - **UNB-EXT-027:** Maintain append-only observations and linked corrections; rebuild normalized projections and retain historical eligibility snapshots.

heading: Ingestion, rights and provenance
text: - **UNB-EXT-028:** Implement monitoring for source updates, status changes, leadership changes, financial filing changes, enforcement events and entity relationships, with severity and review routing.

heading: Ingestion, rights and provenance
text: - **UNB-EXT-029:** Track source-level acquisition costs, compute, storage, human review, licensing and business value; broad acquisition must remain economically sustainable.

heading: Ingestion, rights and provenance
text: - **UNB-EXT-030:** Record evidence confidence and source authority separately; an AI summary, journalist allegation, charity self-report and IRS record cannot be treated as equivalent.

heading: Ingestion, rights and provenance
text: - **UNB-EXT-031:** Support independent verification of high-impact claims and a dispute/correction channel for charities and sponsors.

heading: Ingestion, rights and provenance
text: - **UNB-EXT-032:** Define ingestion APIs, job checkpoints, retries, backpressure, deduplication, versioning, tenant scoping, quarantine and safe failure without contaminating approved eligibility.

heading: Ingestion, rights and provenance
text: - **UNB-EXT-033:** Keep internally generated sponsor-private assessments separate from lawful common-source data; no cross-partner sharing without authority.

heading: Ingestion, rights and provenance
text: - **UNB-EXT-034:** Maintain a searchable, evidence-linked historical knowledge graph and source lineage usable by deterministic eligibility policies and bounded AI assistance.

heading: Ingestion, rights and provenance
text: - **UNB-EXT-035:** Any future external charity-data API product requires explicit licensing, provenance, confidentiality, security, quality and commercial review; no assumption all collected data can be resold.

heading: Ingestion, rights and provenance
text: - **UNB-EXT-036:** Support an offline or source-outage degraded mode using last-known data clearly marked as such; freshness-sensitive approvals may be held.

heading: Ingestion, rights and provenance
text: - **UNB-EXT-037:** Each data source requires a measured ingestion/quality acceptance gate before being treated as production authoritative evidence.

heading: Ingestion, rights and provenance
text: - **UNB-EXT-038:** Source registry and coverage map must be exportable, reviewable and versioned for audit.

heading: Canonical identity and organizational history
text: - **UNB-CHAR-001:** Assign each organization an immutable Unbound Charity ID independent of EIN, name, address or external identifiers.

heading: Canonical identity and organizational history
text: - **UNB-CHAR-002:** Track legal name, DBA/aliases, historic names, EIN and jurisdiction-specific identifiers, incorporation, tax classification, registered address, operating locations, contacts and websites with effective dates and provenance.

heading: Canonical identity and organizational history
text: - **UNB-CHAR-003:** Support charities with no US EIN, fiscal sponsorship, religious organizations, government entities, schools, foreign organizations and other legally relevant entity types; do not assume all are US 501(c)(3)s.

heading: Canonical identity and organizational history
text: - **UNB-CHAR-004:** Model merger, dissolution, reinstatement, name change, EIN change, fiscal-sponsor relationship and successor entity without overwriting history.

heading: Canonical identity and organizational history
text: - **UNB-CHAR-005:** Detect potential duplicates through deterministic identifiers and probabilistic similarity, but require controlled review before merging; preserve split/unmerge and source lineage.

heading: Canonical identity and organizational history
text: - **UNB-CHAR-006:** Keep identity confidence separate from grant eligibility, fraud risk and payment beneficiary verification.

heading: Canonical identity and organizational history
text: - **UNB-CHAR-007:** Record ownership, legal control, contacts, officers and leadership only when lawful and relevant; minimize personal information and protect sensitive records.

heading: Canonical identity and organizational history
text: - **UNB-CHAR-008:** Preserve immutable evidence documents, original source payload, retrieval timestamp, effective date, checksum, licensing/redistribution terms and validation method.

heading: Canonical identity and organizational history
text: - **UNB-CHAR-009:** Provide entity relationship graph for affiliates, fiscal sponsors, related organizations, chapters and renamed entities, with typed, time-bounded, evidence-backed edges.

heading: In-house source acquisition and stewardship
text: - **UNB-CHAR-010:** Maintain first-party ingestion connectors for applicable primary sources, including IRS Tax Exempt Organization Search datasets, IRS exemption/revocation records, government registration records and direct charity attestations; verify actual availability, completeness, permitted use and refresh frequency.

heading: In-house source acquisition and stewardship
text: - **UNB-CHAR-011:** Track source freshness, last successful refresh, source coverage, known gaps, exceptions, licensing and retention rules. Never label a stale source current.

heading: In-house source acquisition and stewardship
text: - **UNB-CHAR-012:** Normalize raw observations into canonical organization claims while retaining conflicting claims and their provenance; no silent last-write-wins.

heading: In-house source acquisition and stewardship
text: - **UNB-CHAR-013:** Support internal stewardship queues for ambiguous identities, conflicting registrations, suspect documents, stale attestations and unmatched grantees.

heading: In-house source acquisition and stewardship
text: - **UNB-CHAR-014:** Maintain controlled verification workflows for charities to submit evidence, confirm details and dispute incorrect records; submissions are claims until validated.

heading: In-house source acquisition and stewardship
text: - **UNB-CHAR-015:** Support scheduled and event-driven monitoring of revocation, reinstatement, address changes, organization dissolution, sanction changes and other policy-relevant events.

heading: In-house source acquisition and stewardship
text: - **UNB-CHAR-016:** Do not treat absence from a dataset as proof of ineligibility; apply source coverage and entity-type-aware rules.

heading: In-house source acquisition and stewardship
text: - **UNB-CHAR-017:** Establish retention, correction, right-of-response and dispute policies for organization data, including audit trails and privacy obligations.

heading: Eligibility and decisioning
text: - **UNB-CHAR-018:** Separate factual organization status, sponsor-specific grant eligibility, jurisdiction-specific legal applicability, recipient due diligence, payment-readiness and risk assessment.

heading: Eligibility and decisioning
text: - **UNB-CHAR-019:** Represent eligibility as a time-bound, evidence-backed decision for a specific sponsor, program, grant purpose, geography, amount and date; not a universal boolean.

heading: Eligibility and decisioning
text: - **UNB-CHAR-020:** Sponsor policy engine SHALL evaluate tax classification, public charity status where required, private foundation and supporting organization considerations, foreign grant requirements, prohibited benefits, conflicts, sanctions and grant restrictions as applicable, with legal review of rules.

heading: Eligibility and decisioning
text: - **UNB-CHAR-021:** Record decision result as Eligible, Ineligible, NeedsReview or InsufficientEvidence with reasons, rule versions, source observations and authorized reviewer.

heading: Eligibility and decisioning
text: - **UNB-CHAR-022:** Use deterministic policy gates for eligibility and disbursement authority; AI may extract, reconcile, flag and propose, but may not fabricate evidence or self-approve exceptions.

heading: Eligibility and decisioning
text: - **UNB-CHAR-023:** Allow sponsor-specific overrides only within lawful and approved policy boundaries, with reason, evidence, expiry, scope and independent review.

heading: Eligibility and decisioning
text: - **UNB-CHAR-024:** Trigger reevaluation when primary-source status changes, policy changes, grant purpose changes, relevant amount thresholds change or evidence expires.

heading: Eligibility and decisioning
text: - **UNB-CHAR-025:** Historical eligibility decisions and the exact source evidence relied upon remain reproducible, even when later evidence contradicts them.

heading: Eligibility and decisioning
text: - **UNB-CHAR-026:** Distinguish identity verification, charity eligibility, payment beneficiary authentication and sanctions checks; passing one never implies passing all.

heading: Eligibility and decisioning
text: - **UNB-CHAR-027:** Maintain grantee-specific grant history, restrictions, prior diligence, complaints and sponsor interactions with strict confidentiality and partner scoping.

heading: Risk and fraud controls
text: - **UNB-CHAR-028:** Detect impersonation, suspicious address/bank changes, duplicate entities, charity hijacking, mismatched EIN/name and anomalous grant patterns; flag as evidence-based signals, not automatic guilt.

heading: Risk and fraud controls
text: - **UNB-CHAR-029:** Payment details are separately verified, protected and access controlled; internal charity registry ownership does not justify exposing bank details broadly.

heading: Risk and fraud controls
text: - **UNB-CHAR-030:** Support risk-based review, escalation, case management, evidence preservation and human resolution.

heading: Risk and fraud controls
text: - **UNB-CHAR-031:** Maintain restricted lists, sponsor-specific exclusions, investigation holds and legally required screening evidence with effective dates.

heading: Risk and fraud controls
text: - **UNB-CHAR-032:** Prevent unverified changes to legal identity or payee data from propagating into approved payment instructions without renewed authorization.

heading: Risk and fraud controls
text: - **UNB-CHAR-033:** Define monitoring alerts with materiality, confidence, freshness and review ownership; no black-box AI risk score as sole disqualification basis.

heading: Internal APIs, UX, documents and isolation
text: - **UNB-CHAR-034:** Versioned internal APIs SHALL cover organization search, identity resolution, source observations, verification cases, status history, eligibility evaluation, evidence, monitoring, disputes, and grant linkage.

heading: Internal APIs, UX, documents and isolation
text: - **UNB-CHAR-035:** All read/write APIs enforce sponsor/partner/program roles, purpose limitation, field-level protection where needed, rate controls, immutable audit and idempotency.

heading: Internal APIs, UX, documents and isolation
text: - **UNB-CHAR-036:** Maintain shared non-sensitive canonical identity facts where legally permissible, while segregating sponsor-specific eligibility decisions, investigations, private submissions, banking details, donor/grant relationships and partner-specific intelligence.

heading: Internal APIs, UX, documents and isolation
text: - **UNB-CHAR-037:** The sharing model must explicitly govern whether sponsor-derived intelligence may improve common registry quality; no cross-partner private-data leakage or unauthorized reuse.

heading: Internal APIs, UX, documents and isolation
text: - **UNB-CHAR-038:** Forma SHALL provide accessible mobile-first organization search, identity disambiguation, source freshness, eligibility reasons, stewardship queues, direct charity verification and sponsor review.

heading: Internal APIs, UX, documents and isolation
text: - **UNB-CHAR-039:** Folio SHALL produce reproducible organization verification packs, eligibility decision records, due-diligence summaries, charity correspondence and audit evidence with source/version references.

heading: Internal APIs, UX, documents and isolation
text: - **UNB-CHAR-040:** Strata-backed immutable observations and decisions SHALL support linked corrections, temporal queries, source replay and integrity verification, subject to actual Strata capability validation.

heading: Internal APIs, UX, documents and isolation
text: - **UNB-CHAR-041:** Support bulk import and migration of sponsor charity records without treating unverified legacy labels as current authoritative status.

heading: Internal APIs, UX, documents and isolation
text: - **UNB-CHAR-042:** Internal data must remain exportable under authorized sponsor contracts and legal requirements; avoid lock-in via undocumented proprietary identifiers.

heading: Requirements

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-RULE-002**: Distinguish federal tax deductibility, IRS exemption, state corporate standing, solicitation obligations, sanctions restrictions, international grant rules and sponsor policy.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-RULE-003**: Represent statutory exemptions explicitly and require evidence supporting applicability; absence from a registry is not automatically disqualifying.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-RULE-004**: Evaluate relevant jurisdictions based on legal entity, solicitation activities, sponsor domicile, grant location, recipient location and applicable transaction facts; do not infer a universal jurisdiction from mailing address.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-RULE-005**: Support effective-date and recorded-date history for rules, source facts, interpretations and decisions.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-RULE-006**: Maintain separately legal applicability confidence, evidence sufficiency, identity certainty and operational risk; avoid a misleading single charity score.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-RULE-007**: Do not permit AI-generated interpretations to become binding rules without authorized legal/compliance review.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-RULE-008**: Preserve authoritative government source citations and source-specific freshness/rights restrictions in every decision.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-RULE-009**: Treat source absence, access outage, stale data, exemption and negative regulatory findings as different states.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-RULE-011**: Separate charity identity, legal recipient/payee, fiscal sponsor and charitable project in evaluation.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-RULE-012**: Provide bounded deterministic rules for well-supported cases; uncertain legal or conflicting factual questions route to humans.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-RULE-013**: Enforce sponsor approval authority and delegation limits; AI can recommend, explain and gather evidence but cannot authorize prohibited grants.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-RULE-014**: Block downstream grant execution when legally prohibited, sanctions status unresolved at required threshold, identity uncertain or approval absent.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-RULE-015**: Define source and decision freshness thresholds by jurisdiction and risk, including rechecks before money movement where required.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-RULE-016**: Record explicit reasons and evidence for both approval recommendations and denials/holds.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-RULE-017**: Allow sponsor-specific policies while preserving shared legally sourced facts and tenant isolation.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-RULE-018**: Evaluate legal changes prospectively and retroactively when applicable, with impact analysis on prior grants; never silently rewrite historical decisions.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-RULE-019**: Support policy simulation and shadow evaluation before activating changed rules.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-RULE-020**: Require authorized dual control for high-risk policy/rule changes and material overrides.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-RULE-021**: No manual override may bypass an actual legal prohibition; permitted exception paths require documented authority.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-RULE-022**: Maintain legal interpretation review queues and track unresolved ambiguity without asserting certainty.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-RULE-023**: Expose explainable eligibility decisions through governed APIs, accessible Forma stewardship UI and reproducible Folio dossiers.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-RULE-024**: Support recurring monitoring, change-triggered reevaluation and sponsor notification when material status changes.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-RULE-025**: Track jurisdiction-specific regulatory requirements independently from whether a particular state publishes a usable machine-readable dataset.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-RULE-026**: Preserve rule and evidence lineage into accounting, grant approvals and payment instruction controls without granting execution authority.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-RULE-027**: Test source conflict, outdated rules, exemptions, identity collisions, cross-border cases and adversarial AI recommendations.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-RULE-028**: Implement source-rights, privacy and confidentiality controls on evidence exposed to partners, advisors, agents and downstream APIs.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-RULE-029**: Distinguish counsel-reviewed legal assertions from research hypotheses and vendor/agency guidance; no research note automatically becomes production law.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-RULE-030**: Provide deterministic replay of past decisions from pinned source, rule, policy and identity snapshots.

heading: Cross-cutting requirements
text: - **OPS-001** (Governance): Every control has immutable identity and version history.

heading: Cross-cutting requirements
text: - **OPS-002** (Compliance): Applicability decisions are jurisdiction-, sponsor-, partner-, entity- and period-aware.

heading: Cross-cutting requirements
text: - **OPS-003** (Governance): Each control records risk, objective, obligations, materiality and dependency relationships.

heading: Cross-cutting requirements
text: - **OPS-004** (Governance): Each active control has a named owner, backup and independent reviewer.

heading: Cross-cutting requirements
text: - **OPS-005** (Security): Owner and reviewer conflicts are prevented by authorization rules.

heading: Cross-cutting requirements
text: - **OPS-006** (Governance): Delegation and reassignment require acceptance, expiry and full history.

heading: Cross-cutting requirements
text: - **OPS-007** (AI): Agents may draft controls and cases but cannot activate, self-review or self-certify.

heading: Cross-cutting requirements
text: - **OPS-008** (Governance): Control activation requires approved version, scope, evidence producer and failure behavior.

heading: Cross-cutting requirements
text: - **OPS-009** (Assurance): Evidence expectation is explicit for transactions, schedules, exceptions and zero activity.

heading: Cross-cutting requirements
text: - **OPS-010** (Assurance): Missing or stale evidence never becomes automatic pass.

heading: Cross-cutting requirements
text: - **OPS-011** (Assurance): Control results preserve independent evidence, denominator, evaluated period and scope.

heading: Cross-cutting requirements
text: - **OPS-012** (Security): Monitoring failures create deficiencies with safe operational fallback.

heading: Cross-cutting requirements
text: - **OPS-013** (Governance): Control changes trigger dependency impact assessment and reapproval when material.

heading: Cross-cutting requirements
text: - **OPS-014** (Assurance): Historical evaluations remain tied to effective control versions.

heading: Cross-cutting requirements
text: - **OPS-015** (Testing): Negative tests and sample populations are defined before assurance claims.

heading: Cross-cutting requirements
text: - **OPS-016** (Testing): Testing distinguishes design validation from operating effectiveness.

heading: Cross-cutting requirements
text: - **OPS-017** (Risk): Deficiencies have severity, exposure, ownership, due date, remediation and retest.

heading: Cross-cutting requirements
text: - **OPS-018** (Risk): Deficiency closure requires independent evidence and reviewer authority.

heading: Cross-cutting requirements
text: - **OPS-019** (Risk): Compensating controls have documented expiry, limits and independent approval.

heading: Cross-cutting requirements
text: - **OPS-020** (Governance): Emergency suspension preserves mandatory legal and financial safety constraints.

heading: Cross-cutting requirements
text: - **OPS-021** (Governance): Retirement requires dependency review and successor/no-longer-applicable justification.

heading: Cross-cutting requirements
text: - **OPS-022** (Reporting): Control dashboards cannot label design completion as regulatory compliance.

heading: Cross-cutting requirements
text: - **OPS-023** (Reporting): Evidence exports include missing items, redaction, provenance and limitations.

heading: Cross-cutting requirements
text: - **OPS-024** (Security): Every material action is auditable and tenant-isolated.

heading: Cross-cutting requirements
text: - **OPS-025** (Architecture): Control operations support sponsor and partner variation without duplicating authoritative policy.

heading: Cross-cutting requirements
text: - **OPS-026** (UI): Control ownership and reviewer tasks are accessible on mobile and desktop.

heading: Cross-cutting requirements
text: - **OPS-027** (UI): Tasks show next authorized action, reason, urgency and evidence required.

heading: Cross-cutting requirements
text: - **OPS-028** (Finance): Financial controls bind independent source reconciliation and accounting assertions.

heading: Cross-cutting requirements
text: - **OPS-029** (Compliance): Legal assertions require qualified review and versioned applicability.

heading: Cross-cutting requirements
text: - **OPS-030** (Finance): Live payment execution remains prohibited until separately authorized.

heading: Cross-cutting requirements
text: - **OPS-031** (Governance): Control-to-requirement mappings require semantic review, not keyword coverage alone.

heading: Cross-cutting requirements
text: - **OPS-032** (Governance): Sponsor administration cannot bypass independent governance or legal authority.

heading: Design gaps that require new or strengthened controls
text: - **GAP-V01 Sponsor authority provenance:** board-approved delegation, effective date, scope and quorum must be independently evidenced.

heading: Design gaps that require new or strengthened controls
text: - **GAP-V02 Legal-rule lifecycle:** versioned counsel-approved legal assertions and jurisdiction-specific effective dates; no AI-authored rules activated.

heading: Design gaps that require new or strengthened controls
text: - **GAP-V03 Eligibility change between approval and payment:** reevaluation triggers, freshness and hold semantics.

heading: Design gaps that require new or strengthened controls
text: - **GAP-V04 Reconciliation independence:** ledger and custody cannot both derive from the same imported feed and count as two independent sources.

heading: Design gaps that require new or strengthened controls
text: - **GAP-V05 Payment egress safety:** simulated adapter plus network egress deny and alert; design alone is not an executed safety test.

heading: Design gaps that require new or strengthened controls
text: - **GAP-V06 Missing-log detection:** independently monitored expected-evidence schedule, not a heartbeat produced only by the system being monitored.

heading: Design gaps that require new or strengthened controls
text: - **GAP-V07 Evidence privacy:** prevent cross-tenant exposure and unnecessary secret/PII logging while preserving chain of custody.

heading: Design gaps that require new or strengthened controls
text: - **GAP-V08 Auditor truthfulness:** synthetic fixtures and unverified controls excluded from claims of operating effectiveness.

heading: Design gaps that require new or strengthened controls
text: - **GAP-V09 Exception closure independence:** the same agent cannot be sole actor, verifier and reviewer.

heading: Design gaps that require new or strengthened controls
text: - **GAP-V10 Approval mutation:** changes to approved recipient, amount, funding sources or conditions trigger explicit reapproval policy.

heading: Design gaps that require new or strengthened controls
text: - **GAP-V11 Regulatory research source recovery:** locate actual REG/CTL assertions in daf-landscape before mapping; earlier code search returned no matches.

heading: Design gaps that require new or strengthened controls
text: - **GAP-V12 Full corpus coverage:** inspect remaining requirements, not just the 15 source documents used in wave 2.

heading: Mandatory requirements
text: MATRIX-001 Every requirement, business workflow, API, agent, data source and operational procedure must map to applicable control IDs and a documented nonapplicability decision where appropriate.

heading: Mandatory requirements
text: MATRIX-002 Controls must have accountable named owners assigned before implementation; current owners are role placeholders.

heading: Mandatory requirements
text: MATRIX-003 Evidence must identify event, actor, authorization, action, outcome, system, timestamp, source integrity, policy version, environment, tenant scope, retention and reviewer.

heading: Mandatory requirements
text: MATRIX-004 Monitor missing expected evidence and failed control operations, not just successful logs.

heading: Mandatory requirements
text: MATRIX-005 Do not log secrets, unnecessary personal data or restricted documents in generalized logs.

heading: Mandatory requirements
text: MATRIX-006 Preserve segregation of duties, sponsor discretion, independent reconciliation and legal restrictions even when an AI agent recommends an action.

heading: Mandatory requirements
text: MATRIX-007 Track lifecycle Proposed, Designed, Implemented, Operating, Tested, AuditorReviewed; mark deficiencies and remediation separately. Require observed evidence for every advancement.

heading: Mandatory requirements
text: MATRIX-008 Scope SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria with qualified auditor; Security baseline and additional criteria only as applicable. Current CC5/CC6/CC7 mappings are **candidates**, not validated AICPA criterion-by-criterion mappings.

heading: Mandatory requirements
text: MATRIX-009 Track DAF legal, fiduciary, tax and financial reporting obligations separately from SOC 2; overlapping evidence does not establish compliance with all.

heading: Mandatory requirements
text: MATRIX-010 Require negative/adversarial tests, exception escalation, time-bounded evidence packages and independent review.

heading: Mandatory requirements
text: MATRIX-011 Preserve production evidence separately from synthetic/test evidence; no claims of SOC 2 attestation, Type I/II or operating effectiveness without independent evidence.

heading: Mandatory requirements
text: MATRIX-012 Live outbound payment execution remains deferred and prohibited until separate authorization.

heading: Binding directive
text: SOC2-001: Every claimed control MUST have a unique ID, scope, control owner, objective, risk, procedure, frequency/trigger, evidence schema, source system, retention, reviewer, failure/escalation behavior and test method.

heading: Binding directive
text: SOC2-002: Every business or security-significant event MUST generate attributable, tamper-evident, time-stamped evidence including actor, authority, action, resource, decision, result, correlation ID and policy/version where applicable.

heading: Binding directive
text: SOC2-003: Logging MUST be risk-based and privacy-aware; prohibit secrets, credentials, unnecessary sensitive personal data, raw restricted charity documents and unrestricted prompt contents in general logs.

heading: Binding directive
text: SOC2-004: Control evidence MUST be generated as a byproduct of normal operations wherever feasible, not manually assembled only before audit.

heading: Binding directive
text: SOC2-005: Evidence MUST show both successful operation and failures, denials, exceptions, remediation, reviews and overdue controls.

heading: Binding directive
text: SOC2-006: Design immutable/append-only audit records, integrity verification, independent protected storage, restricted access, backup and retention/legal hold; actual implementation to be validated.

heading: Binding directive
text: SOC2-007: All requirements and PRs MUST map to applicable control IDs, tests, evidence artifacts and owners; absence requires documented non-applicability decision.

heading: Binding directive
text: SOC2-008: No control may be marked implemented, operating, tested or audit-ready without actual observed evidence and review.

heading: Binding directive
text: SOC2-009: Control evidence MUST be exportable into auditor-ready, time-bounded, reproducible Folio packages with chain of custody and access redaction.

heading: Binding directive
text: SOC2-010: Access management MUST cover MFA, provisioning/deprovisioning, least privilege, privileged access, service identities, agent identities and periodic review.

heading: Binding directive
text: SOC2-011: Change management MUST cover approvals, source provenance, CI checks, testing, deployment records, rollback and emergency changes.

heading: Binding directive
text: SOC2-012: Security monitoring MUST cover authentication, authorization failures, administrative actions, data access/export, agent activity, configuration changes, anomalous events and incident handling.

heading: Binding directive
text: SOC2-013: Risk and vendor management MUST inventory critical services, subservice organizations, shared responsibilities, due diligence, contracts and ongoing monitoring.

heading: Binding directive
text: SOC2-014: Data classification, privacy, encryption, retention, deletion and legal holds MUST be defined and enforced consistently, including sponsor/partner isolation.

heading: Binding directive
text: SOC2-015: Backup, disaster recovery, availability objectives, incident response, tabletop exercises and recovery tests MUST produce dated evidence.

heading: Binding directive
text: SOC2-016: Vulnerability, dependency, secret, infrastructure and penetration testing programs MUST record findings, prioritization, fixes, exceptions and retest evidence.

heading: Binding directive
text: SOC2-017: AI agents MUST be individually attributable, bounded by authorization, monitored, testable and interruptible; prompt/tool changes and sensitive tool invocations MUST be governed.

heading: Binding directive
text: SOC2-018: Financial and grant controls MUST preserve sponsor authority, approvals, reconciliation, anti-fraud checks and separation of duties.

heading: Binding directive
text: SOC2-019: A central control register MUST distinguish Proposed, Designed, Implemented, Operating, Tested, Deficient, Remediating and AuditorReviewed; never infer one state from another.

heading: Binding directive
text: SOC2-020: Control claims in marketing, contracts and reports MUST be reconciled to actual scope, implemented controls, evidence and independent attestation.

heading: Binding directive
text: SOC2-021: Define system boundaries, commitments, service description, infrastructure, people, processes, data and relevant third parties before selecting final criteria.

heading: Binding directive
text: SOC2-022: Define management's description and complementary user entity controls and subservice organization controls where relevant.

heading: Binding directive
text: SOC2-023: Set audit period, evidence retention and review cadence with qualified auditor and counsel; do not invent universal retention periods.

heading: Binding directive
text: SOC2-024: Control owners MUST periodically attest to operation, and independent reviewers MUST challenge evidence completeness and effectiveness.

heading: Binding directive
text: SOC2-025: Audit events MUST support secure correlation across API, agent, Strata persistence, Forma, Folio, accounting, investments, grants and integrations.

heading: Binding directive
text: SOC2-026: Security incidents and exceptions MUST have documented detection, triage, containment, remediation, communication and lessons learned.

heading: Binding directive
text: SOC2-027: A missing expected log or control heartbeat MUST itself create a monitored control exception.

heading: Binding directive
text: SOC2-028: Source licensing, third-party data rights and permitted AI use MUST be reflected in access, storage, retrieval and exports.

heading: Binding directive
text: SOC2-029: Every future agent directive MUST instruct the agent to identify applicable SOC 2 controls, produce evidence, test negative cases and report any gaps honestly.

heading: Binding directive
text: SOC2-030: Require security/privacy design review before introducing new data categories, external APIs, autonomous permissions or financial workflows.

heading: Binding directive
text: SOC2-031: Keep production evidence distinct from test/synthetic evidence and identify environment, period and provenance.

heading: Binding directive
text: SOC2-032: Support retention and lawful deletion policies without pretending append-only logs exempt personal data from privacy obligations.

heading: Binding directive
text: SOC2-033: Record policy exceptions with risk acceptance authority, expiration, compensating controls and follow-up.

heading: Binding directive
text: SOC2-034: Use objective coverage metrics: controls with owners, evidence emitted, missed runs, evidence integrity, overdue access reviews, remediation aging and tested effectiveness.

heading: Binding directive
text: SOC2-035: Maintain a versioned control-to-system-to-evidence-to-test crosswalk.

heading: Binding directive
text: SOC2-036: Require explicit approval before publicly claiming SOC 2 compliance or a Type I/II report; no such status exists merely from these requirements.

heading: Requirements
text: GOV-AUTH-001: Maintain an enterprise authority registry mapping every command, actor, sponsor legal entity, partner, DAF, risk class, scope, conditions, approval and delegated authority expiration.

heading: Requirements
text: GOV-AUTH-002: Explicitly separate recommendation, approval, accounting recognition, trading instruction, payment instruction, payment execution and settlement.

heading: Requirements
text: GOV-AUTH-003: No AI agent may grant itself permissions, approve its own consequential action or change its own authority policy.

heading: Requirements
text: GOV-AUTH-004: Segregation of duties applies across humans, service accounts and agents; prevent one actor controlling request, approval and reconciliation.

heading: Requirements
text: GOV-AUTH-005: Support dual control, committees, quorum, recusals, conflict disclosures, substitute approvers and emergency authority with post-event review.

heading: Requirements
text: GOV-AUTH-006: Require cryptographically attributable identity, strong authentication and least privilege for every material command.

heading: Requirements
text: GOV-AUTH-007: Model sponsor board, officers, compliance, grants, finance, investment committee, security, charity steward, partner and donor/advisor roles without conflating them.

heading: Requirements
text: GOV-AUTH-008: Every action must be checked against policy version, authority limits, effective dates, fund restrictions, available liquidity and regulatory blocks.

heading: Requirements
text: GOV-AUTH-009: Human approval must identify the exact proposal and evidence snapshot; material changes invalidate or trigger reapproval.

heading: Requirements
text: GOV-AUTH-010: Agents may automate evidence gathering and reversible internal steps only under explicit approved authority and monitored boundaries.

heading: Requirements
text: GOV-AUTH-011: Agent-generated claims and legal interpretations cannot become binding controls without authorized review.

heading: Requirements
text: GOV-AUTH-012: Log every material authority decision, denied command, override request, approval, delegation and privilege change in tamper-evident records.

heading: Requirements
text: GOV-AUTH-013: Route uncertain authority, suspected fraud, conflicts, stale evidence and material exceptions to authorized humans.

heading: Requirements
text: GOV-AUTH-014: Require independent financial reconciliation; the agent initiating a transaction cannot attest to its independent settlement.

heading: Requirements
text: GOV-AUTH-015: Support temporary delegated authority with expiration, revocation and immediate propagation.

heading: Requirements
text: GOV-AUTH-016: Partner isolation applies to policy, approvals, cases and audit evidence.

heading: Requirements
text: GOV-AUTH-017: Maintain accessible Forma approval workspaces and reproducible Folio decision packages.

heading: Requirements
text: GOV-AUTH-018: Run shadow-mode simulations and adversarial tests before enabling autonomous consequential actions.

heading: Requirements
text: GOV-AUTH-019: No production live outbound payment rail is authorized by this requirements document.

heading: Requirements
text: GOV-AUTH-020: Produce SOC 2 control/evidence records for authority configuration, changes, execution, exception handling and periodic access review.

heading: Requirements
text: GOV-AUTH-021: Keep authorization policy enforcement deterministic and independently testable; AI explanations do not replace enforcement.

heading: Requirements
text: GOV-AUTH-022: Preserve append-only event history and replayable decisions; verify actual Strata capabilities before implementation.

heading: Requirements
text: GOV-AUTH-023: Use governed F# APIs for all actions, not direct agent database writes.

heading: Requirements
text: GOV-AUTH-024: Define emergency stop, agent suspension, safe mode and human takeover, with evidence and recovery approval.

heading: Requirements
text: GOV-AUTH-025: Review authority assignments periodically and upon role changes, departures, DAF succession or partner termination.

heading: Requirements
text: GOV-AUTH-026: Require explicit control ownership and service-level escalation for unattended operations.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GRANT-001:** Recommendations never create donor legal entitlement or unilateral asset movement; sponsor authority governs approval.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GRANT-002:** Capture intent, purpose, beneficiary, suggested amount, anonymity/public recognition preferences and restrictions separately.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GRANT-003:** Support one-time, scheduled, recurring, conditional, multi-year and milestone-based recommendations with explicit approval and revalidation rules.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GRANT-004:** Support fixed-dollar grants and percentages of a precisely defined eligible valuation base, with valuation date/lock and rounding policy.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GRANT-005:** Support multiple investment funding sources with independently defined amount or allocation percentages, liquidity and source restrictions.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GRANT-006:** Separate grant percentage-of-base from investment-source allocation percentages; validate each independently.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GRANT-007:** Resolve canonical charity identity, legal payee, fiscal sponsor, project and payment destination as separate facts.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GRANT-008:** Pin versioned charity evidence, jurisdictional rules, sponsor policy and recipient eligibility to each decision.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GRANT-009:** Recheck time-sensitive identity, sanctions and eligibility conditions at policy-defined stages, including prior to eventual execution.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GRANT-010:** Apply sponsor, program, DAF, donor intent and restricted-fund policies in explicit precedence order with legal prohibitions always controlling.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GRANT-011:** Evaluate prohibited benefits, conflicts of interest, pledges, earmarking and other legal/policy concerns, escalating uncertain cases to qualified review.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GRANT-012:** Route human approvals according to role, amount, risk, relationship, exception and delegation limits; enforce dual control where required.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GRANT-013:** AI can prepare recommendations, collect evidence and identify issues but cannot override sponsor authority, legal blocks or financial controls.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GRANT-014:** Keep approval, grant commitment, accounting expense recognition, payable recognition, liquidity allocation, payment instruction and settlement distinct.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GRANT-015:** Recognize grants and payables only under approved accounting policy and applicable obligations, not automatically upon recommendation.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GRANT-016:** Ensure GL/subledger entries are balanced, attributable to DAF/fund/legal entity, append-only and linked to grant events.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GRANT-017:** Reserve or encumber available balances only under explicit accounting and fund-availability policy; prevent double allocation.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GRANT-018:** Model segregated custody, pooled unitized investments, omnibus accounts and external managers without conflating investment preference with trading authority.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GRANT-019:** Reconcile investment redemptions, cash availability, custody settlement, sponsor funding and grant payable independently.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GRANT-020:** Handle partial liquidity, failed redemption, stale NAV, corrected valuation, FX, fees and funding-source substitution with approval and audit trail.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GRANT-021:** Prepare provider-neutral payment instructions, beneficiaries, remittance references, fraud checks, idempotency keys and approval evidence; live execution remains disabled until separately authorized.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GRANT-022:** Distinguish prepared, approved, submitted, accepted, rejected, settled, returned and reconciled payment states; never infer settlement from submission.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GRANT-023:** Support grants to domestic public charities, qualifying fiscal sponsors and other permitted recipients, with legal review for nonstandard and international grants.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GRANT-024:** Support grant agreements, restrictions, milestones, reporting obligations, conditional release and grant purpose amendments.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GRANT-025:** Support donor anonymity and communications preferences while meeting sponsor, grantee, legal and operational disclosure obligations.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GRANT-026:** Provide grantee onboarding, secure verification of organization and payment details, change-of-bank anti-fraud controls and acknowledgement collection.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GRANT-027:** Handle recurring grants when charity eligibility, DAF funding, donor role or sponsor policy changes between installments.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GRANT-028:** Model cancellation, withdrawal, expiration, declined grants, returns, refunds, clawbacks, disputed grants and corrective regranting without erasing history.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GRANT-029:** Handle duplicate recommendations and replayed requests idempotently; detect suspicious repeated or split grants.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GRANT-030:** Support grant batching and straight-through processing for low-risk cases without bypassing required approval or accounting checks.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GRANT-031:** Maintain accessible donor, sponsor operator and grantee views with role-specific next best action, status and clear explanations.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GRANT-032:** Use Forma mobile-first WCAG 2.2 AA-targeted components and Folio reproducible grant letters, agreements, reports and audit packages.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GRANT-033:** Publish governed APIs for recommendations, eligibility, funding, approvals, commitments, payables, payment instructions, acknowledgments, reporting, exceptions and reconciliation.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GRANT-034:** Support partner/tenant isolation, scoped advisors, multiple participants and successor DAF accounts throughout the grant lifecycle.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GRANT-035:** Preserve donor intent and advisory history when advisor authority changes or DAF succession occurs; outstanding grants require sponsor-governed transition rules.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GRANT-036:** Model service-level objectives, queues, ownership, aging, exception severity, escalation and communications across the entire process.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GRANT-037:** Generate evidence-backed explanations of grant delays and required next steps without revealing restricted intelligence or private partner data.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GRANT-038:** Allow authorized retrospective replay of every decision using pinned rules, policies, evidence, NAV, balances, approvals and timestamps.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GRANT-039:** Distinguish grant award date, accounting recognition date, payment date, settlement date, grantee receipt and completion date.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GRANT-040:** Support tax/regulatory reporting evidence and financial-statement reconciliation without asserting unverified legal reporting obligations.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GRANT-041:** Support international grants only through separately approved due diligence, sanctions, equivalency/expenditure-responsibility and payment/legal frameworks as applicable.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GRANT-042:** Treat grantee impact reports as evidence with provenance, not automatically verified outcomes.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GRANT-043:** Support grant portfolios, charitable strategies, recurring commitments and longitudinal outcomes across multiple DAFs and participants, subject to permissions.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GRANT-044:** Model grant-specific fraud threats, payment detail substitution, fake charity identity, insider override, social engineering and conflicting approvals.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GRANT-045:** Implement versioned policies for minimum/maximum grant sizes, payout schedules, funding order, restricted assets and fee treatment.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GRANT-046:** Ensure grant workflow can operate with a simulated payment adapter and synthetic settlement evidence while real rails remain deferred.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GRANT-047:** Prevent payment preparation from bypassing accounting/eligibility checks, and prohibit live execution in requirements-stage environments.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GRANT-048:** Require human approval of material grant modifications after sponsor approval, with appropriate re-evaluation and new accounting effects.

heading: Illustrative cross-domain scenarios

heading: Illustrative cross-domain scenarios

heading: Illustrative cross-domain scenarios

heading: Exception classes and mandatory response
text: - **EXC-01 Eligibility drift:** source change or stale sanctions check after approval -> hold advancement, reevaluate evidence, request compliance decision.

heading: Exception classes and mandatory response
text: - **EXC-02 Identity ambiguity:** same-name charity, changed EIN, fiscal sponsor confusion -> quarantine recipient association and require steward review.

heading: Exception classes and mandatory response
text: - **EXC-03 Funding shortfall:** available liquidity below approved funding plan -> do not overdraw; propose approved alternate allocation or defer.

heading: Exception classes and mandatory response
text: - **EXC-04 Redemption failure/partial fill:** reconcile positions and available cash; propose partial funding or replacement source within sponsor rules.

heading: Exception classes and mandatory response
text: - **EXC-05 NAV correction:** pin original valuation and correction; calculate impact, accounting adjustment and reapproval threshold.

heading: Exception classes and mandatory response
text: - **EXC-06 Ledger/custodian mismatch:** quarantine financial close and investigate independent evidence; do not fabricate balancing entry.

heading: Exception classes and mandatory response
text: - **EXC-07 Payment state mismatch:** distinguish instruction, provider acceptance, bank settlement and grantee receipt; unresolved state is not paid.

heading: Exception classes and mandatory response
text: - **EXC-08 Returned or recalled payment:** reopen payable/receivable as appropriate under accounting policy, verify beneficiary and seek authorization.

heading: Exception classes and mandatory response
text: - **EXC-09 Bank detail substitution:** block payment instruction advancement until independently verified by an approved channel.

heading: Exception classes and mandatory response
text: - **EXC-10 Duplicate/split grants:** detect idempotency/recommendation fingerprint and policy evasion; preserve legitimate recurring installments.

heading: Exception classes and mandatory response
text: - **EXC-11 Grant conditions unmet:** suspend future installments; obtain sponsor determination and preserve donor communications.

heading: Exception classes and mandatory response
text: - **EXC-12 Cross-tenant exposure:** deny disclosure, alert security and isolate affected projections and credentials.

heading: Exception classes and mandatory response
text: - **EXC-13 Source outage or stale evidence:** use explicitly labeled last-known information only where policy permits, otherwise hold.

heading: Exception classes and mandatory response
text: - **EXC-14 Approval authority conflict:** freeze transition and obtain valid delegation/dual approval.

heading: Exception classes and mandatory response
text: - **EXC-15 Retroactive legal change:** run historical impact analysis; do not rewrite past approval.

heading: Exception classes and mandatory response
text: - **EXC-16 Reporting discrepancy:** preserve grantee claim and contradictory evidence, seek clarification; do not auto-assert fraud.

heading: Exception classes and mandatory response
text: - **EXC-17 Sponsor succession/DAF transfer:** reconcile authority and outstanding grant commitments before continuing.

heading: Exception classes and mandatory response
text: - **EXC-18 Reconciliation break after close:** create post-close adjustment/reopening case according to policy, preserve original close package.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GEX-001:** Publish typed, versioned event schemas with compatibility tests and deterministic replay.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GEX-002:** All authoritative events append-only with linked corrections/reversals; Strata implementation must be verified.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GEX-003:** Enforce idempotency and per-aggregate ordering; handle late, duplicated and out-of-order external observations.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GEX-004:** Preserve event causation, correlation, evidence, actor authority, tenant and legal entity context.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GEX-005:** Every exception has accountable owner, severity, SLA, escalation, evidence and closure proof.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GEX-006:** Detect expected/actual state divergence across grants, GL, custody, bank, recipient and payment simulation.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GEX-007:** Exception detection never silently creates balancing accounting entries or alters external financial facts.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GEX-008:** Agents may diagnose, retrieve evidence and propose remedies, but execution authority is separately bounded and audited.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GEX-009:** Categorize resolutions as automated-safe, human-approved, counsel/compliance-reviewed or prohibited.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GEX-010:** No automated remedy may override a legal prohibition, sponsor discretion or required financial approval.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GEX-011:** Apply least privilege, partner isolation, PII controls and source-rights restrictions to case evidence and agent context.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GEX-012:** Use policy-driven financial exposure and reversibility thresholds for auto-remediation; default to hold when unknown.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GEX-013:** Every automated resolution produces a reason, evidence chain, policy version and before/after projection.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GEX-014:** Support compensation and reversal workflows instead of assuming distributed actions are atomic.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GEX-015:** Distinguish business completion, accounting recognition, cash settlement and grantee acknowledgment.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GEX-016:** A funding failure cannot be resolved by treating unavailable cash as available.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GEX-017:** NAV corrections trigger impacted grant/fund/accounting review with immutable historical valuations.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GEX-018:** Material recipient bank-detail changes require independent verification and dual control per policy.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GEX-019:** Source evidence changes trigger only impacted eligibility reevaluations with appropriate decision freshness.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GEX-020:** Support retry with bounded attempts/backoff, poison-message quarantine and operator replay.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GEX-021:** Provide case deduplication, dependency graph and parent/child cases to avoid alert storms.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GEX-022:** Provide outcome-based prioritization using legal risk, money exposure, deadline, recipient impact and confidence.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GEX-023:** Track false positives, time to detect, time to resolve, reopened cases and human interventions.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GEX-024:** Support deterministic replay and simulation of exception policy changes before production activation.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GEX-025:** Separate case resolution approval from posting to GL, trading, grant approval and future payment execution.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GEX-026:** Forma UI shows next best action, evidence, comparison, authority, aging and safe available remedies.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GEX-027:** Folio exports complete case dossiers, immutable decision histories and reconciliation evidence.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GEX-028:** All case/event APIs are governed, versioned and accessible without mandating microservices.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GEX-029:** Support sponsor, partner, program and DAF scoped access and multiple advisor/successor roles.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GEX-030:** Prevent automated case closure without explicit verification of expected financial and regulatory outcomes.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GEX-031:** Use provider-neutral payment states and a simulated adapter; no live rail selected or authorized.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GEX-032:** Preserve evidence of upstream system outage and distinguish unknown from confirmed failure.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GEX-033:** Escalate uncertain legal interpretations and suspected fraud rather than automatically deciding culpability.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GEX-034:** Require explicit schema version migration, event catalog crosswalk and event producer ownership.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GEX-035:** Model compensating actions as separately authorized, immutable business events, not edits.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GEX-036:** Validate independent financial sources before reconciling, with no self-confirming ledger/custodian loop.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GEX-037:** Support manual intervention with reason codes, role checks, evidence and immutable audit.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GEX-038:** Define case retention, privacy, legal hold and rights policies compatible with append-only history.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GEX-039:** Require synthetic fault injection and cross-domain tests before any auto-remediation class is activated.

heading: Requirements
text: - **UNB-GEX-040:** Never equate event emission with successful external execution or settlement.

heading: Requirement set
text: - **UNB-GFUND-001:** Grant recommendation supports FixedAmount(currency,amount) and Percentage(rate,baseSpecification,valuationPoint) as mutually explicit amount modes; a percentage without its base is invalid.

heading: Requirement set
text: - **UNB-GFUND-002:** Percentage bases support approved choices: a named investment/pool, selected eligible investment positions, selected portfolios, total eligible DAF net asset value, or eligible available-to-recommend balance. These bases are not interchangeable; show the exact basis before confirmation.

heading: Requirement set
text: - **UNB-GFUND-003:** Funding source selections support multiple eligible custody accounts, pool positions, investment portfolios and cash balances, with sponsor policy determining permitted source types.

heading: Requirement set
text: - **UNB-GFUND-004:** A fixed grant amount may specify allocation by exact monetary amounts or percentages summing to 100%; mixed modes require explicit normalization policy, not implicit guessing.

heading: Requirement set
text: - **UNB-GFUND-005:** A percentage-based grant may be funded pro rata across selected investments or by independently specified funding weights. The percentage that calculates grant size is separate from the weights used to source it.

heading: Requirement set
text: - **UNB-GFUND-006:** Show projected charity award, source-level allocations, estimated liquidation proceeds, estimated fees, available settled cash, unsettled proceeds and funding shortfall independently.

heading: Requirement set
text: - **UNB-GFUND-007:** Define valuation basis, price timestamp, cutoff, rounding, source currency, FX rate and expiration/requote threshold for percentage grants and liquidation estimates.

heading: Requirement set
text: - **UNB-GFUND-008:** Support dollar amount and percentage input, editing and preview in mobile-first accessible Forma UI, including clear labels for percentage base versus allocation weights.

heading: Requirement set
text: - **UNB-GFUND-009:** Validate source-level ownership/attribution, participant permissions, fund restrictions, sponsor liquidity policy, grant limits, pending redemptions, existing commitments and sufficient available balance before sponsor approval.

heading: Requirement set
text: - **UNB-GFUND-010:** An advisory recommendation cannot directly trigger trade execution, grant payable recognition or disbursement; each has distinct authorized states and evidence.

heading: Requirement set
text: - **UNB-GFUND-011:** When investments must be liquidated, generate a proposed funding plan that accounts for pool redemption cutoffs, liquidity gates, securities settlement, market holidays, fees and tax-lot rules where applicable.

heading: Requirement set
text: - **UNB-GFUND-012:** Sponsor may approve the proposed allocation, modify it under policy with a recorded explanation, request renewed advisor consent where policy requires, or reject/hold it.

heading: Requirement set
text: - **UNB-GFUND-013:** Market value movement after recommendation SHALL not silently alter a fixed-dollar grant. Percentage-based grants require an explicit policy deciding whether the amount locks at recommendation, sponsor approval or execution, with clear preview and immutable snapshot.

heading: Requirement set
text: - **UNB-GFUND-014:** Support insufficient liquidity, price drift, partial redemptions, restricted assets, failed trades, failed settlement, custodian outage and grant cancellation with explicit recovery and reapproval rules.

heading: Requirement set
text: - **UNB-GFUND-015:** Permit partial funding and staged settlement only under approved grant policy, and distinguish authorized grant amount from paid, payable and pending funding amounts.

heading: Requirement set
text: - **UNB-GFUND-016:** Source allocation rounding SHALL be deterministic; for a fixed grant, the sum of source allocation amounts equals the intended funding amount, with documented residual handling.

heading: Requirement set
text: - **UNB-GFUND-017:** Cross-currency allocations must use approved exchange-rate timing and separate FX risk/fees from the charity's award currency and amount.

heading: Requirement set
text: - **UNB-GFUND-018:** Support reusable allocation templates and sponsor-approved default funding waterfalls (cash-first, pro rata, specified order), without overriding a donor's explicit approved preference silently.

heading: Requirement set
text: - **UNB-GFUND-019:** Record immutable recommendation, amount calculation, selected source IDs, percentages, valuation evidence, approvals, funding plan, actual redemptions, accounting journals, grant payment and reconciliations.

heading: Requirement set
text: - **UNB-GFUND-020:** Reconcile fund investment position reductions, unit redemptions, custody proceeds, cash, grants payable, payment settlement and fund available-to-recommend balance, with no double counting.

heading: Requirement set
text: - **UNB-GFUND-021:** Prevent concurrent recommendations or liquidation requests from committing the same liquidity twice using controlled reservations, authorization and idempotency.

heading: Requirement set
text: - **UNB-GFUND-022:** Grant funding instructions SHALL remain distinct from investment rebalancing requests; selling a position to finance a grant is not automatically a mandate to rebalance the remaining portfolio.

heading: Requirement set
text: - **UNB-GFUND-023:** A grant may target one or multiple grantee recipients only through explicitly modeled separate grant awards and payment obligations; do not silently split a single recipient's award.

heading: Requirement set
text: - **UNB-GFUND-024:** A percentage-based recurring grant requires explicit frequency, valuation point, maximum amount, minimum, renewal, sponsor approval policy and stop conditions; recurring percentages are not assumed from a one-time instruction.

heading: Requirement set
text: - **UNB-GFUND-025:** Forma shall display source-by-source projected and actual funding, accessible on mobile, with clear estimated/final labels and screen-reader-readable breakdowns.

heading: Requirement set
text: - **UNB-GFUND-026:** Folio shall generate reproducible grant recommendations, approval notices, funding breakdowns, grant letters, investment liquidation evidence and reconciliation reports with policy/source version references.

heading: Requirement set
text: - **UNB-GFUND-027:** All funding allocation APIs shall be versioned, tenant/fund scoped, idempotent, independently authorized and auditable; AI can propose a funding mix but cannot self-approve trades or grant payments.

heading: Requirement set
text: - **UNB-GFUND-028:** Partner isolation applies to selected accounts, positions, prices, allocations, source credentials, evidence, reports and AI context, including multi-custodian structures.

heading: Requirement set
text: - **UNB-GFUND-029:** The system shall support fund-wide percentage grants when investments include both segregated accounts and unitized pools, with no double-counting of look-through assets.

heading: Requirement set
text: - **UNB-GFUND-030:** Support in-kind grant proposals only where sponsor policy, recipient acceptance, legal eligibility and custody capability permit; default cash grant settlement must not assume assets can be transferred directly.
